enumDescriptions: Ask before running a cell that matches `mdRunbook.execution.confirmPatterns`.
Never ask (cells with the `confirm` option still ask).
mdRunbook.execution.confirm.markdownDescription: When to show a confirmation dialog before running a cell. The `confirm` / `no-confirm` cell options override this per cell. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot weaken it.

mdRunbook.execution.confirmPatterns.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expressions (case-insensitive) for risky commands. A cell whose text matches one asks for confirmation before it runs; declining records it as `exit=declined` (still pending for progress and Resume Run) and stops Run All. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot weaken it.

mdRunbook.output.recordContext.markdownDescription: Commands whose first output line is recorded as an attribute of each output block, e.g. `{ "context": "kubectl config current-context" }` writes `context=prod-eu`. Run through the platform shell in the .md file's folder with a 5 s timeout; failures record `unknown`. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot weaken it.

mdRunbook.output.recordContextCacheSecon.description: Reuse recorded context values for this many seconds per runbook instead of running the commands before every cell. 0 = run them every time.

mdRunbook.statusBar.contextAttr.markdownDescription: Which `mdRunbook.output.recordContext` attribute to show in the status bar for the active runbook.

mdRunbook.cellOptions.enabled.markdownDescription: Apply per-cell options from the fence line (`timeout=`, `cwd=`, `env.NAME=`, `continue-on-error`, `skip`, `confirm`). Turn off to ignore options written in runbooks.

mdRunbook.execution.allowNoConfirmOption.markdownDescription: Honour the `no-confirm` cell option. Off by default: a runbook (or an assistant editing it) must not be able to switch off the risky-command confirmation. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot weaken it.
